thread:
deploy-bot: Post-deploy quickcheck: release v3.4.1 -> us-west-canary (5%) flagged probe 'nlp-embed-smoke' on 4 hosts. p95 560ms (baseline 170ms), errors 3.8% (baseline 0.2%). Probe rule: failfast when errors >1% or p95 >300ms. Link: https://runbooks/release-smoke. @sre-oncall @irene please take

sam: Pulled the probe traces. The failures are 502/timeout coming from inference-proxy. Model containers report normal CPU/GPU and low latency. Looks like proxy thread pool exhaustion or FD leak.

nirav: Which hosts?

sam: Hosts: i-03ff22aa, i-0bb33cc4, i-0dd44ee5, i-09988aa7. Healthcheck output from one host:

```
$ curl -sS http://i-03ff22aa.internal/_health
{"status":"degraded","proxy_upstream_errors":42,"inflight":95}
```

irene: We just flipped runtime prefill config earlier — but that change is limited to model runtime, shouldn't affect proxy. Still, safe plan: pause rollout, keep canaries alive for debugging, and route user traffic to v3.4.0.

sre-oncall: Agreed. Pause now. Avoid org-wide rollback until we confirm proxy-level cause. Also add emergency guard: if aggregate errors >2% for 10m we roll back.

sam: Kicking off targeted synths against the four hosts with header X-Canary:1. Command: `scripts/synth --probe nlp-embed-smoke --hosts i-03ff22aa,i-0bb33cc4,i-0dd44ee5,i-09988aa7 --count 100 --header \"X-Canary:1\"`

nirav: Nice. I also grabbed `ss -s` and `cat /proc/$(pidof inference-proxy)/limits` — shows Max open files 1024, current open fds ~980 on the worst host. That explains intermittent upstream failures.

nirav: Proposed quick fix: graceful restart of inference-proxy on affected hosts to reclaim fds, and bump systemd LimitNOFILE to 65536 in the unit for the next deploy. We can script a safe restart (disable traffic, restart, re-enable).

nirav: I'll run restart sequence on the hosts one at a time.

sam: Before restart, snapshot lsof and tcp stats for postmortem. Command I used:

```
sudo lsof -p $(pidof inference-proxy) | wc -l > /tmp/fd-count.before
ss -tanp | grep inference-proxy | wc -l > /tmp/estab.before
```

deploy-bot: Action: rollout paused at 5% (actioned by irene). Rerouting production traffic to v3.4.0 for affected allocation at 6501234580.

irene: Restarting proxy on i-03ff22aa now (graceful stop, wait 10s, start).

deploy-bot: Event: inference-proxy restart completed on i-03ff22aa at 6501234592.

sam: Re-running targeted synth against i-03ff22aa: 2/100 failures (was 14/100). Good improvement.

nirav: Restarting i-0bb33cc4 -> completed. Post-restart synth: 0/100 failures.

sre-oncall: Looks like fd pressure was the root cause. Proceed: keep rollout paused for 20m for stability window. Do not change systemd limits in prod via hotfix; instead schedule config change in next infra roll with coordinated deploy.

irene: I'll update release notes: "v3.4.1: canary routing paused due to proxy upstream timeouts on canary hosts; mitigated by targeted proxy restarts; follow-up: increase LimitNOFILE for inference-proxy and add FD preflight to synth-run."

sam: Filed infra ticket INFRA-4521 to bump LimitNOFILE and add unit-tests. Also adding a synth-run preflight step to check open fds and fail early.

sre-oncall: Agreed. New rule: deploy-bot preflight must verify Max open files >= 8192 for proxy hosts prior to canary routing. I'll add to runbook.

deploy-bot: Artifact: logs uploaded -> /artifacts/releases/v3.4.1/proxy-fd-snapshots-6501234567.tar.gz

irav: After two hosts restarted, aggregated probe error down to 0.4% across canary. Still keeping slowed ramp. If stable for 20m, resume ramp to 25% with 10m observation windows.

sam: Will follow up with postmortem note and stack traces in the ticket.

deploy-bot: Thread closed for now; will reopen if quickcheck breaches thresholds. Ping @sre-oncall to escalate.
